description: Create (or connect) the user's free HelpySelf account from inside the conversation, so calls stop hitting the no-account limits (sign_in_required, too_many_files, daily_limit). Ask the user for their email first; never guess one. HelpySelf emails them a link; they press Allow; then call get_account_token. Free, no card.

email.description: The user's own email address, as they gave it to you.

language.description: The user's language, for the page they confirm on. Defaults to en.

name: create_account
title: Create a free HelpySelf account
